decision_reason: An audit record for a no-op restore is observably false and violates write-audit accuracy.

causal_assessment.hypothesis: The restore loop omitted the same state guard used by delete and purge.
causal_assessment.falsifier: The controller guarantees every ID is a current deleted row under the same transaction, which it does not.

control_action.target: Report restore state guard and audit
invariants: one successful restore creates one audit
control_action.rollback: revert T14 restore guard and tests
correction_check: deleted ID restores and audits once
